description:
About the company
 Our client is an artificial intelligence company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Carry out hands-on research on publicly available neural networks, testing methods for the early and refinement stages of learning, and build the measurement tools that confirm whether a change genuinely helps. The role takes a research question from first idea through to a working implementation, working closely with engineers who build production systems, and calls for a high degree of independence.
 What you'll do
 - Plan and carry out studies on publicly available neural networks, choosing the learning method that suits each question.
 - Build systems that transform records of human work into material suitable for learning.
 - Explore ways to represent workflows, context and decisions so that model performance improves.
 - Create measures of output quality and dependability across lengthy, multi-step tasks.
 - Set up repeatable experiment and training routines.
 - Work alongside infrastructure engineers to move proven methods into live systems.
 - Take a research question from first idea to a working result, owning each step.
 - Investigate failed training runs and tell real gains apart from results that only look promising.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 2 to 5 years of relevant experience.
 - Practical, hands-on time with publicly available neural networks, including their foundational or refinement training phases.
 - Coding proficiency proven by building research prototypes, learning infrastructure or repeatable test setups.
 - Track record standing up data preparation flows for learning systems and gauging trained model quality.
 - Experience designing studies independently and working out why training runs fail.
 - Sound grasp of how data quality, parameter tuning, measurement and study design interact.
 - Ability to turn research findings into measurable gains on extended tasks.
 - Comfort working on-site five days per week.
 Bonus points
 - Prior work at an organization centered on applied AI is a plus.
 - Work with models that learn from records of how people carry out tasks.
 - Familiarity with making learning runs faster and cheaper, or with spreading computation across many machines.
 - Shared research outputs or public code that others can use.
 - Startup or entrepreneurial experience.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, United States
 - On-site, five days per week in office
 - Full-time
